facts.fact: The COMESA IDEA report says evaluation of the Government Service Bus redesign and re-engineering procurement in Zambia is complete and under World Bank review, and three consultants have been engaged to assess GSB operations, governance, technical capacity and infrastructure.

note: Other IDEA countries (Malawi, Angola) name exchange platforms but this call answers for ZMB only; Zambia's section does not say the GSB is live, count its connections or give usage figures. as_of is the end of the January-June 2026 reporting period.
